notes.title: Bold Blade update v1.02
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31645195/ccdb6b7855ee1d8d5fa9d36e5dc5ddfc868f4cea.png[/img]
Changes in v1.02
[list]
    [*]New Game+ gold drops increase
    [*]Psi Power Menu doesn't open on menus or credits
    [*]Psi Powers only usable in levels
    [*]Enemies' swords now consistently do damage
    [*]Master Blade, Beetle Basher, Cricket Crusher, Devotee of the Voiceless achievements fixed
    [*]New Game+ difficulty adjusted
    [*]Psi Power Menu unlocks when you get first Psi Power
    [*]Add programs used to credits
[/list]

notes.title: Soundtrack now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31645195/dce0eb296c7f8e5d4011a50552c1e0fd7d784ecd.png[/img]
It's the soundtrack of Bold Blade, in MP3 and FLAC formats! 8 tracks, making up 5+ minutes of music composed by Jesse Gallagher.

Besides music, if you want to show your support for the development team, you can post a review, give your kudos on the community group, gift the game to your friends, and/or you can get this DLC as a small token to us.

[h1]Bundles now available:[/h1]
Bold Blade Soundtrack Edition
10% off Bold Blade and the official soundtrack

Ultra Runaway Games Collection
15% off Bold Blade, the Bold Blade soundtrack, and Paper Sorcerer.
